hunks.name: native question status in existing blocked row
hunks.before:
'text',case
          when resolution.mapping_state is distinct from 'RESOLVED' then 'Needs correction'
hunks.after:
'text',case
          when resolution.blocker_code='PAID_SHIFT_OVERLAP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' then 'Paid shift needs matching'
          when resolution.mapping_state is distinct from 'RESOLVED' then 'Needs correction'

hunks.name: paid matching plain problem
hunks.after:
'problem',case
        when resolution.blocker_code='PAID_SHIFT_OVERLAP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' then case
          when paid_question.value->>'state'='READY' then 'Confirm whether this is the paid shift or separate work.'
          else 'The paid-shift comparison is unavailable. Recheck the current payment and source authority.' end
        when resolution.blocker_code='PROTECTED_SHIFT_MATCH_REQUIRED'

hunks.name: finite distinct question action
hunks.after:
'label',case when resolution.blocker_code='PAID_SHIFT_OVERLAP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' then case
            when paid_question.value->>'state'='READY' then 'Confirm paid shift match' else 'View details' end
          when resolution.blocker_code='PROTECTED_SHIFT_MATCH_REQUIRED' then 'Confirm shift match'

hunks.name: bounded native DTO without raw paid facts
